purpose: Expose the exact initialized LayerRegistry instances needed for reuse planning without creating, destroying, selecting, or executing any layer.

snapshot.fingerprint: sha256 over canonical ordered live instance records
snapshot.state_identity_scope: live structure plus validated init identity and parameter count; current numerical weight/state bytes are not included

instance.init_identity: variant + flags + canonical validated init payload

consistency.live_map_vs_init_identity: snapshot fails closed if a live instance lacks its canonical init identity or an init identity lacks a live instance
consistency.parameter_count: snapshot fails closed if summed live parameter counts differ from LayerRegistry totalParams
consistency.destroyed_instances: excluded because successful destroy removes the live map entry and init identity

planner_boundary.operation_binding: deferred to a separate protocol-identity-to-operation projection

invariants: inventory is derived from current LayerRegistry state and never from AgentWorkspace mirrors
inventory enumeration does not initialize, destroy, mutate, forward, compile, or execute layers
inventory does not infer graph.layer operation IDs from protocol layer_type/variant values
inventory_fingerprint is correlation/provenance only and is not authorization
identical inventory fingerprints do not claim identical numerical weights unless a future explicit state digest contract proves that separately
a live instance is reported only when LayerRegistry and canonical init identity agree
future_extensions: machine-readable protocol layer_type/variant to operation_id mapping
planner resolution between exact reuse candidate and constructible initialization path
optional numerical state digest bound separately from init identity
